E2E.description: E2E is the top-level document type for declarative end-to-end tests.

imports.description:
Imports — other E2E files to run after this one, on the same cluster
unless an import sets freshCluster.

metadata.description: Metadata — the test's name and description, shown in results.

spec.description: Spec — the Blueprint under test, the cluster, setup and expectations.

E2EInit.description: E2EInit selects a built-in example pack as the test source.

example.description: Example — the example inside the pack to test.

pack.description: Pack — the example pack, as in inrun init --pack.

enabled.description:
Enabled controls whether Inrun runtime health checks are performed.
Defaults to true.

blueprint.description:
Blueprint is the path to the blueprint.yaml file. Without one the test
is plain Kubernetes: Inrun generates no bundle and installs nothing.

cr.description: CR is the path to the CR YAML file to apply during the test.

crFiles.description:
CRFiles is a list of additional CR YAML files. Applied in declaration order
after CR. Use when the test needs multiple CR instances or kinds.

crd.description:
CRD is the path to the CRD YAML file for this operator.
Applied before the bundle and before Inrun starts.

crdFiles.description:
CRDFiles is a list of additional CRD YAML files. Applied in declaration order
after CRD. Use when the operator manages multiple custom resource

env.description:
Env declares environment variables available to all expectations in this
e2e spec. Values support variable expansion.

environment.description:
Environment is the cluster the run executes against and the
infrastructure it needs before the test's own dependencies are
installed: the cluster itself, the images to build and load, and
cluster furniture (namespaces, an ingress controller, a storage class)
that the prepare phase's charts and manifests expect to exist.

expect.description: Expect is the list of expectations to check after each lifecycle event.

finally.description:
Finally declares operations to run once for the suite at its end —
whether it passed, failed or stopped early, setup failures included —
before teardown. It is a post block, like an expectation's finally: its
failures are warnings, never the result. Use it to undo what the suite
changed outside the cluster, such as a file it wrote.

functions.description:
Functions declares user-defined functions available in when:/or: expressions.
Same syntax as a Blueprint functions block — same FuncMap registration, same functions.

init.description: Init uses an example pack — for Inrun's own CI.

onFailure.description:
OnFailure declares operations to run once for the suite when any
expectation, or the setup before them, fails. It is a post block: the
same commands, kubectl and external as a step, run once, with output
printed and failures reported as warnings.

prepare.description:
Prepare is the test's own dependencies and the workload under test:
ecosystem infrastructure (Postgres, RabbitMQ, Redis) and the manifests
and charts that install the workload.

runtime.description: Runtime controls runtime-specific behavior during the e2e test.

valuesFiles.description:
ValuesFiles is a list of Helm values files passed to the Inrun chart
installation during e2e. Paths are relative to the e2e.yaml file.
Use this to configure custom runtime images or any other Helm values
without requiring --values flags on the command line — useful when e2e
runs automatically during inrun push.

KELFunctionRegistry.description: KELFunctionRegistry holds user-defined functions merged from a Blueprint and its spec.imports Modules.

definitions.description: Definitions — the functions, each a named template expression.

include.description:
Include — a YAML file, relative to this one, whose definitions: list is
added before the definitions here.

anyOf.description: Prepare is the second phase of a run: the test's own dependencies and the workload under test.

apply.description:
Apply is an ordered list of manifests to kubectl-apply.
Each entry is either a plain path string or a {path, wait} struct.

ecosystem.description: Ecosystem declares infrastructure dependencies and their Secrets.

helm.description:
Helm is an ordered list of Helm charts to install.
Executed as helm upgrade --install.

wait.description:
Wait blocks until all listed resources exist and satisfy conditions.
Runs after all apply and helm steps. Use per-entry wait for ordered checks.

Prepare.description: Prepare is the second phase of a run: the test's own dependencies and the workload under test.

UserDefinedFunction.description: UserDefinedFunction is a named template expression declared in a Blueprint or Module.

description.description: Description — shown by inrun validate and in the function list.

expression.description:
Expression is a Go template string evaluated by the Resolver.
Built-in functions and other user-defined functions (same Blueprint or imported) are
available inside the expression. The result is always a string.

name.description: Name — how templates call the function.

shadow.description: Shadow: true acknowledges that this function intentionally overrides a built-in.

assert.Assertions.description: Assertions checks a step's output: one comparison inline, a list under text, path-scoped ones under json.

between.description: Between — the output, as a number, is inside an inclusive "min,max".

contains.description: Contains — the output contains this text.

equals.description: Equals — the output is exactly this text.

exists.description: Exists — true: the output is non-empty; false: it is empty.

expr.description:
Expr — an expression that must come out true: ${ … } is CEL, {{ … }}
a template, both with KEL's functions. value is what is asserted on
(a number, boolean, list or map when it is JSON, else the text) and,
under json:, object is the whole document.

greaterThan.description: GreaterThan — the output, as a number, is above this one (strict).

in.description: In — the output is one of a comma-separated list.

json.description: JSON — comparisons on values in JSON output, by dot path.

lessThan.description: LessThan — the output, as a number, is below this one (strict).

match.description:
Match — what the JSON output must contain, in its own shape: every
key given there and matching, lists element by element, a literal
equal, a ${ … } or {{ … }} value an expression that must be true. It
is checked as the json: assertions MatchAssertions makes of it.

max.description: Max — the output, as a number, is at most this.

min.description: Min — the output, as a number, is at least this.

notBetween.description: NotBetween — the output, as a number, is outside an inclusive "min,max".

notContains.description: NotContains — the output does not contain this text.

notEquals.description: NotEquals — the output is not this text.

notExists.description: NotExists — true: the output is empty; false: it is non-empty.

notIn.description: NotIn — the output is none of a comma-separated list.

notPrefix.description: NotPrefix — the output does not start with this text.

notSuffix.description: NotSuffix — the output does not end with this text.

prefix.description: Prefix — the output starts with this text.

regex.description: Regex — the output matches this RE2 pattern.

suffix.description: Suffix — the output ends with this text.

text.description: Text — comparisons on the output, in order.

condition.Condition.description: Condition is one test against a data map.

between.description: Between passes when the field's number is inside an inclusive "min,max" range.

contains.description: Contains passes when the field's value contains this text.

cron.description:
Cron — a standard cron expression (5-field) that defines when the
window opens. Duration defines how long the window stays open.
Without Duration, the window stays open until the next fire. Add Duration to close it sooner.

dayOfWeek.description:
DayOfWeek — active on the specified days of the week.
  or:
    - dayOfWeek:
        in: [Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday]

duration.description: Duration — how long a cron-opened window remains active.

equals.description: Equals passes when the field's value is exactly this text.

field.description:
Field — dot-notation path to the value tested, e.g. "spec.environment",
"metrics.queueDepth". A template expression is resolved first.

greaterThan.description: GreaterThan passes when the field's number is above this one (strict).

in.description: In passes when the field's value is one of a comma-separated list.

lessThan.description: LessThan passes when the field's number is below this one (strict).

max.description: Max is an inclusive upper bound: the field's number is at most this.

min.description: Min is an inclusive lower bound: the field's number is at least this.

negate.description:
Negate — when true, the result of this condition is inverted.
Applies to all condition types: field comparisons, time windows, dayOfWeek, cron.

  when:
    - dayOfWeek:
        weekday: true
      negate: true   # passes on weekends

notBetween.description: NotBetween passes when the field's number is outside an inclusive "min,max" range.

notContains.description: NotContains passes when the field's value does not contain this text.

notEquals.description: NotEquals passes when the field's value is not this text.

notExists.description:
NotExists, when true, passes when the field is absent or empty;
false is exists: true.

notIn.description: NotIn passes when the field's value is none of a comma-separated list.

notPrefix.description: NotPrefix passes when the field's value does not start with this text.

notSuffix.description: NotSuffix passes when the field's value does not end with this text.

prefix.description: Prefix passes when the field's value starts with this text.

regex.description: Regex passes when the field's value matches this RE2 pattern.

suffix.description: Suffix passes when the field's value ends with this text.

time.description:
Time — active when the current time is within the declared window.
After and Before are both optional; omit one for a half-open range.
  or:
    - time:
        after: "08:00"
        before: "20:00"

typeOf.description:
TypeOf passes when the field's value has this type: map, slice,
string, number, bool or null.

unique.description:
Unique, when true, passes when no other object has the same value at
Field. Always passes where no UniquenessChecker is in the data.

condition.DayOfWeek.description: DayOfWeek declares which days the condition is active.

in.description: In — active on these days. Full English names: Monday, Tuesday, etc.

notIn.description: NotIn — active on all days except these.

weekday.description: Weekday — active Mon–Fri. Shorthand for in: [Monday..Friday].

weekend.description: Weekend — active Sat–Sun. Shorthand for in: [Saturday, Sunday].

condition.TimeWindow.description: TimeWindow declares a clock-based active window.

after.description: After — active after this time (format: "HH:MM" in 24h).

before.description: Before — active before this time (format: "HH:MM" in 24h).

duration.Duration.description: A duration: Go units (15s, 2m, 1h) or d, w, mo, y

anyOf.description: ApplyEntries are manifests to apply, in order: written as one path, a list of paths, or entries with their own waits.

spec.ApplyEntries.description: ApplyEntries are manifests to apply, in order: written as one path, a list of paths, or entries with their own waits.

anyOf.description: ApplyEntry is a single manifest to kubectl-apply during setup.

include.description:
Include names a file whose apply entries replace this one, their
paths resolved from that file. It stands alone.

path.description: Path is the YAML file path to kubectl-apply.

wait.description: Wait blocks after this apply until all listed resources satisfy their conditions.

spec.ApplyEntry.description: ApplyEntry is a single manifest to kubectl-apply during setup.

spec.Cluster.description: Cluster controls cluster creation and selection.

name.description: Name is the kind cluster name. Default: "inrun-e2e".

provider.description: Provider is the cluster backend. Defaults to kind.

reuse.description:
Reuse controls whether an existing cluster is reused or recreated.
false (default) — delete and recreate for a clean state.
true — reuse existing cluster if it exists.

spec.Command.description: Command runs a shell command and asserts its result.

assert.description:
Assert checks the output with the full block: also supports text: lists
and json: path-scoped comparisons.

between.description: Between — the output, as a number, is inside an inclusive "min,max".

contains.description: Contains — the output contains this text.

equals.description: Equals — the output is exactly this text.

exists.description: Exists — true: the output is non-empty; false: it is empty.

exitCode.description:
ExitCode is the expected exit code. Default 0 (success).
Set to non-zero to assert the command must fail — useful for
admission webhook rejection tests.

expr.description:
Expr — an expression that must come out true: ${ … } is CEL, {{ … }}
a template, both with KEL's functions. value is what is asserted on
(a number, boolean, list or map when it is JSON, else the text) and,
under json:, object is the whole document.

greaterThan.description: GreaterThan — the output, as a number, is above this one (strict).

in.description: In — the output is one of a comma-separated list.

jq.description: JQ selects one value from JSON output with a jq expression (requires format: json and jq).

json.description:
JSON is a list of path/value assertions on the command's JSON output,
without nesting under assert:.

jsonPath.description: JSONPath selects one value from JSON output by dot path (in-process).

lessThan.description: LessThan — the output, as a number, is below this one (strict).

run.description:
Run is a shell command string executed via sh -c. Only ${{ env.NAME }}
is expanded first, as in GitHub Actions: the shell expands $NAME and
${NAME} itself, from the process environment the declared env is added
to.

suffix.description: Suffix — the output ends with this text.

yq.description: YQ selects one value from YAML output with a yq expression (requires format: yaml yq).

spec.Commands.description: Commands are commands, run in order.

spec.Ecosystem.description: Ecosystem declares the data services a run needs and the Secrets that carry their connection details to the workload.

namespace.description: Namespace is where the instances live. Default: "data".

postgres.description:
Postgres, MariaDB (MySQL protocol), RabbitMQ, Redis and Kafka declare
the services. Each is optional; only what is declared is installed.

secrets.description:
Secrets declares how the resolved connection details reach the
workload: export writes the tool's canonical variables, define writes
Secrets the test names with the app's own keys.

spec.EcosystemDefine.description: EcosystemDefine is a Secret the test names.

keys.description:
Keys maps the app's variable names to connection details, each
tool.field:

	keys:
	  DATABASE_URL: postgres.url
	  KAFKA_BOOTSTRAP: kafka.bootstrap

namespace.description: Namespace is the Secret namespace. Default: "default".

spec.EcosystemExport.description: EcosystemExport writes the canonical variables for the named tools.

namespace.description: Namespace is the Secret namespace. Default: "default".

replicas.description: Replicas is the replica count. Default: 1.

storage.description: Storage is the volume size. Default: "1Gi".

topics.description: Topics lists the topics to create.

user.description: User is the application user (a login role for Postgres). Default: "app".

spec.EcosystemSecrets.description: EcosystemSecrets declares how dependency connection details reach the workload.

define.description:
Define writes Secrets the test names, with the app's own keys and
resolver paths.

export.description:
Export writes the tool's canonical variables (POSTGRES_URL, REDIS_HOST,
…) for the named tools into one Secret.

spec.Environment.description: Environment is the first phase of a run: the cluster it executes against and the infrastructure it needs before the test's own dependencies are installed.

apply.description:
Apply is an ordered list of manifests to kubectl-apply.
Each entry is either a plain path string or a {path, wait} struct.

cluster.description: Cluster controls which cluster to use and how it is provisioned.

ecosystem.description:
Ecosystem is the data services the workload uses (Postgres, MariaDB,
RabbitMQ, Redis, Kafka) and the Secrets with their connection details,
installed after the images and before apply, helm and wait.

helm.description:
Helm is an ordered list of Helm charts to install.
Executed as helm upgrade --install.

images.description:
Images lists container images to build and load into the cluster before
the test runs. Kind-only: each image is loaded with `kind load`.

Manifests that reference these images must set imagePullPolicy to
IfNotPresent or Never. A manifest with imagePullPolicy: Always ignores
the loaded image and pulls from the registry instead.

The CLI flag --images narrows this list; it cannot add images the
schema does not declare. When this list is empty, the CLI flag is the
only source — the CI case, where the just-built image is the point.

wait.description:
Wait blocks until all listed resources exist and satisfy conditions.
Runs after all apply and helm steps. Use per-entry wait for ordered checks.

spec.Expectation.description: Expectation is one named assertion block.

after.description:
After is the lifecycle event that triggers this expectation.
Valid values: "setup-complete", "cr-applied", "cr-deleted".

commands.description: Commands are shell commands checked in the same polling loop as resources.

env.description:
Env declares environment variables available to this expectation.
Overrides variables declared in the parent E2E spec. ${NAME} in every
other field of the expectation resolves through it.

external.description:
External makes the calls a Blueprint's external: makes — HTTP,
Prometheus, Postgres, Redis, Mongo, Kafka — from the machine running the
test, and asserts on what they return. The step passes when every call
succeeds and its assertions hold.

finally.description:
Finally declares operations to run after this expectation completes —
whether it passed, failed or was skipped — before the next expectation
runs. It is a post block (see SideEffects): its failures are
warnings, never the case's result. Use it to undo what the step changed
in files or cluster state.

include.description:
Include is a path to a YAML file containing a list of Expectation entries.
When set, the file is loaded and its entries are expanded in place of this entry.
All other fields must be empty when include is set.
Relative paths resolve from the e2e.yaml directory.

kubectl.description:
Kubectl is the structured kubectl DSL block.
An alternative to commands: for common kubectl operations — get, logs,
describe, exec, port-forward. Compiles to kubectl invocations internally.
Use commands: for anything that doesn't fit a subcommand.

name.description: Name is printed in the results table.

onFailure.description:
OnFailure declares diagnostic operations to run immediately when this
specific expectation fails. Runs before moving to the next expectation.

or.description:
Or — at least one condition must pass, alongside When if declared..
Functions declared in spec.functions are available as
template expressions: field: '{{ inBusinessHours }}'.

resources.description: Resources is a unified list of resource checks across any kind.

retry.description: Retry is the maximum retry count for one expectation.

timeout.description: Timeout is the maximum time to wait for the expectation to pass.

wait.description:
Wait is an optional duration to sleep before the polling loop starts.
Useful when the previous step needs time to take effect before assertions
should begin — e.g. waiting for enough reconcile cycles to accumulate.
Must be a valid Go duration string (e.g. "10s", "30s").

when.description:
When — all conditions must pass for this expectation to run (AND).
Empty means unconditional. Functions declared in spec.functions are available as
template expressions: field: '{{ inBusinessHours }}'.

spec.Expectations.description: Expectations is a suite's expect list, or an include file's.

spec.ExternalAuth.description: ExternalAuth is where an external call's bearer token comes from: a Secret or an environment variable, exactly one.

header.description: Header carries the token; Authorization by default.

spec.ExternalCheck.description: ExternalCheck is one call an e2e step makes and asserts on.

assert.description:
Assert checks the extracted value. With none, the call succeeding is
the check.

auth.description: Auth sends a bearer token from a Secret or an environment variable.

between.description: Between — the output, as a number, is inside an inclusive "min,max".

body.description: Body is an HTTP request's body; a template.

cacheFor.description: CacheFor keeps a result for this long.

contains.description: Contains — the output contains this text.

continueOnError.description: ContinueOnError records a failed call's result instead of failing.

equals.description: Equals — the output is exactly this text.

exists.description: Exists — true: the output is non-empty; false: it is empty.

expectedStatus.description: ExpectedStatus are the HTTP statuses that succeed; empty: below 400.

expr.description:
Expr — an expression that must come out true: ${ … } is CEL, {{ … }}
a template, both with KEL's functions. value is what is asserted on
(a number, boolean, list or map when it is JSON, else the text) and,
under json:, object is the whole document.

greaterThan.description: GreaterThan — the output, as a number, is above this one (strict).

headers.description: Headers are sent with an HTTP request; values are templates.

in.description: In — the output is one of a comma-separated list.

include.description: Include is a file of external checks, expanded in place of this one.

jq.description: JQ selects one value from JSON output with a jq expression (requires format: json and jq).

jsonPath.description: JSONPath selects one value from JSON output by dot path (in-process).

lessThan.description: LessThan — the output, as a number, is below this one (strict).

max.description: Max — the output, as a number, is at most this.

method.description: Method is the HTTP method; GET by default.

min.description: Min — the output, as a number, is at least this.

name.description: Name labels the call in messages and results.

notBetween.description: NotBetween — the output, as a number, is outside an inclusive "min,max".

notContains.description: NotContains — the output does not contain this text.

notEquals.description: NotEquals — the output is not this text.

notExists.description: NotExists — true: the output is empty; false: it is non-empty.

notIn.description: NotIn — the output is none of a comma-separated list.

notPrefix.description: NotPrefix — the output does not start with this text.

notSuffix.description: NotSuffix — the output does not end with this text.

prefix.description: Prefix — the output starts with this text.

protocol.description: Protocol is http (the default), prometheus, postgres, redis, mongo or kafka.

query.description:
Query is the protocol's query: PromQL, SQL, a Redis command, a Mongo
"db.collection", a Kafka "group/topic" or "@topic"; a template.

regex.description: Regex — the output matches this RE2 pattern.

suffix.description: Suffix — the output ends with this text.

timeout.description: Timeout bounds the call ("10s" by default).

url.description: URL is the endpoint or connection string; a template.

when.description: When and Or decide whether the call is made.

yq.description: YQ selects one value from YAML output with a yq expression (requires format: yaml yq).

spec.Finally.description: Finally declares operations to run after an expectation completes — whether it passed, failed or was skipped — before the next expectation runs.

commands.description: Commands — shell commands, the same as a step's.

spec.Kubectl.description: Kubectl is the structured kubectl DSL block.

apply.description:
Apply applies manifests from a file path or inline YAML/JSON content.
Generates: kubectl apply -f <file>  or  echo '<inline>' | kubectl apply -f -

auth.description:
Auth checks permissions via kubectl auth can-i and asserts the result.
Generates: kubectl auth can-i <verb> <resource> [-n <ns>] [--as <as>]

cp.description:
Cp copies a file out of a container and asserts its content.
Generates: kubectl cp <ns>/<pod>:<src> <tempfile>

delete.description:
Delete deletes resources by file path or by resource identity.
Generates: kubectl delete -f <file>  or  kubectl delete <kind> <name> -n <ns>

describe.description:
Describe asserts kubectl describe output — useful for events and conditions.
Generates: kubectl describe <kind> <name> -n <ns>

events.description:
Events lists Kubernetes events for a specific resource and asserts the output.
Generates: kubectl events --for=<kind>/<name> -n <ns>

exec.description:
Exec runs a command inside a running container and asserts its output.
Generates: kubectl exec -n <ns> <pod> -c <container> -- <command>

get.description:
Get asserts field values on Kubernetes resources.
Generates: kubectl get <kind> <name> -n <ns> -o jsonpath='<field>'

logs.description:
Logs asserts container log output.
Generates: kubectl logs -n <ns> -l <selector> -c <container> --since=<since>

patch.description:
Patch patches a Kubernetes resource with a merge, strategic, or JSON patch.
Generates: kubectl patch <kind> <name> -n <ns> --type=<type> -p '<patch>'

port-forward.description:
PortForward opens a port-forward to a service or pod, makes an HTTP request,
and asserts the response. EnsureCurl is called automatically when any entry
declares a path. Generates: kubectl port-forward + curl.

restart.description:
Restart triggers a rollout restart of a Deployment, StatefulSet, or DaemonSet.
Generates: kubectl rollout restart <kind>/<name> -n <ns>
Waits for the rollout to complete when ready: true (default).
The expect step's timeout governs how long to wait.

scale.description:
Scale sets the replica count on a Deployment, StatefulSet, or ReplicaSet.
Generates: kubectl scale <kind>/<name> --replicas=<n> -n <ns>
Waits for the rollout to complete when ready: true (default).
The expect step's timeout governs how long to wait.

top.description:
Top queries live CPU and memory usage via kubectl top and asserts the output.
Requires metrics-server; installed automatically when entries are present.
Generates: kubectl top <kind> [-n <ns>] [<name> | -l <selector>] [--containers]

namespace.description: Namespace to look in. Defaults to "default".

notBetween.description: NotBetween — the output, as a number, is outside an inclusive "min,max".

notContains.description: NotContains — the output does not contain this text.

notEquals.description: NotEquals — the output is not this text.

notExists.description: NotExists — true: the output is empty; false: it is non-empty.

notIn.description: NotIn — the output is none of a comma-separated list.

notPrefix.description: NotPrefix — the output does not start with this text.

notSuffix.description: NotSuffix — the output does not end with this text.

path.description:
Path is the HTTP path to request after the port-forward is ready.
Default "/" when the check asserts anything or sends a request
(statusCode, assertions, an extractor, method, headers, a body);
without either, only the forward is checked, for a port that doesn't
speak HTTP.

pod.description: Pod is the pod name to port-forward to. Optional when leaderElection is set.

port.description: Port is the service or pod port to forward.

prefix.description: Prefix — the output starts with this text.

regex.description: Regex — the output matches this RE2 pattern.

service.description: Service is the service name to port-forward to. Optional when leaderElection is set.

statusCode.description:
StatusCode asserts the HTTP response status code. When set, the response
body is discarded and only the numeric status is checked (e.g. 404, 200).
Cannot be combined with JQ, YQ, Equals, or OutputContains.

suffix.description: Suffix — the output ends with this text.

wait.description:
Wait is an optional duration to sleep after the port-forward is ready
but before the curl request is made. Useful when the endpoint needs a
moment to stabilise after the connection is established.
Must be a valid Go duration string (e.g. "2s", "5s").

yq.description: YQ selects one value from YAML output with a yq expression (requires format: yaml yq).

spec.KubectlRestart.description: KubectlRestart triggers a rollout restart of a Deployment, StatefulSet, or DaemonSet.

kind.description: Kind is the resource kind: Deployment, StatefulSet, or DaemonSet.

namespace.description: Namespace to target. Defaults to "default".

ready.description: Ready waits for the rollout to complete after the restart. Defaults to true.

spec.KubectlScale.description: KubectlScale sets the replica count on a Deployment, StatefulSet, or ReplicaSet.

kind.description: Kind is the resource kind: Deployment, StatefulSet, or ReplicaSet.

namespace.description: Namespace to target. Defaults to "default".

ready.description: Ready waits for the rollout to complete after scaling. Defaults to true.

replicas.description: Replicas is the desired replica count.

spec.KubectlTop.description: KubectlTop queries live CPU and memory usage via kubectl top and asserts the output.

assert.description: Assert checks the output: the comparisons conditions use.

between.description: Between — the output, as a number, is inside an inclusive "min,max".

containers.description: Containers shows per-container metrics (--containers). Pods only.

contains.description: Contains — the output contains this text.

equals.description: Equals — the output is exactly this text.

exists.description: Exists — true: the output is non-empty; false: it is empty.

expr.description:
Expr — an expression that must come out true: ${ … } is CEL, {{ … }}
a template, both with KEL's functions. value is what is asserted on
(a number, boolean, list or map when it is JSON, else the text) and,
under json:, object is the whole document.

greaterThan.description: GreaterThan — the output, as a number, is above this one (strict).

in.description: In — the output is one of a comma-separated list.

kind.description: Kind is the resource type to query: "pod" or "node".

labelSelector.description: LabelSelector filters pods by label (e.g. "app=my-service"). Pods only.

lessThan.description: LessThan — the output, as a number, is below this one (strict).

max.description: Max — the output, as a number, is at most this.

min.description: Min — the output, as a number, is at least this.

name.description: Name is the pod or node name. Omit to list all.

namespace.description: Namespace to query. Applies to pods only. Default: "default".

notBetween.description: NotBetween — the output, as a number, is outside an inclusive "min,max".

notContains.description: NotContains — the output does not contain this text.

notEquals.description: NotEquals — the output is not this text.

notExists.description: NotExists — true: the output is empty; false: it is non-empty.

notIn.description: NotIn — the output is none of a comma-separated list.

notPrefix.description: NotPrefix — the output does not start with this text.

notSuffix.description: NotSuffix — the output does not end with this text.

prefix.description: Prefix — the output starts with this text.

regex.description: Regex — the output matches this RE2 pattern.

suffix.description: Suffix — the output ends with this text.

spec.OnFailure.description: OnFailure declares operations to run when an expectation fails.

commands.description: Commands — shell commands, the same as a step's.

external.description: External — calls, the same as a step's.

kubectl.description:
Kubectl — the same block as a step's: writes (apply, patch, restart,
scale, delete), then reads (get, logs, describe, …).

stop.description:
Stop halts the run after the diagnostics for this failure. At spec
level it applies to any expectation that fails; at expectation level it
applies only to that one. The failure is still recorded and reported;
Stop only decides whether later expectations run.

spec.ResourceCheck.description: ResourceCheck asserts the state of any Kubernetes resource.

count.description:
Count asserts the exact number of matching resources. nil means "at least 1".
Set to 0 to assert none exist (cleanup check).

kind.description: Kind is the resource kind: Deployment, Service, Secret, ConfigMap.

name.description: Name is the resource name. Empty means any resource of this kind in the namespace.

namespace.description: Namespace to look in. Empty means "default".

ready.description: Ready asserts at least one available replica (Deployments only).

spec.SecretRef.description: SecretRef is a key of a Secret.

spec.Wait.description: Wait describes a single resource to wait for before the operator starts.

kind.description: Kind is the Kubernetes resource kind (e.g. Deployment, Secret, Namespace).

name.description: Name is the exact resource name.

namespace.description: Namespace to look in. Omit for cluster-scoped resources.

ready.description: Ready waits for an available/ready condition, not just existence.

timeout.description: Timeout is a Go duration string. Default: "30s".

spec.Waits.description: Waits are resources to wait for.
